'''Sabre Eight''' was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] that was used by a person during an operation on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]].

==Biography==
During the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Sabre Eight participated in a [[Cularin Militia]] operation to attack the [[Wyrd]], a group of [[Tarasin]] [[Witch/Legends|witches]], in the jungles of Cularin. However, Sabre Eight was attacked by the Wyrd and sent out a message on his comm set to [[Xirossk|Sabre Hilt]], before being killed. The Wyrd then took the comm set from his body.
